note: What a server sends to say a unit is casting a spell. The header names the unit casting, as the casting inside does.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: It settles whether a client brings the caster's position in line for this cast, and nothing else.

bits.name: endCharge
bits.note: Set where the cast ends a charge: a client drops the message unless the caster is charging that same spell. Clear lets a client charge a spell that charges, sending SpellCharge as it does.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The movement sync id the cast was made against. Where it is the unit's latest or newer, a client moves the caster to the cast's launch point.

bits.name: endCharge
bits.note: Set where it ends a charged cast; a client acts on it only while that spell is charging. Clear, a charged cast by the client's own champion starts the charge display.
